title: 技術者のためのコミュニケーション
subtitle: Communications for Engineer
courseType: （Provided by all courses）Liberal Arts CoursesTransdisciplinary Learning
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) Learn how to use active listening techniques
(2) Learn how to use questioning techniques
(3) Learn critical thinking skills
(4) Learn how to build trusting relationships with team members
advice:
This is a basic communication skills course. We will cover the following materials:

1. Basic communication skills
2. Active listening techniques
3. Questioning techniques
4. Critical thinking skills
5. Team communication

Students are required to participate actively in class.
Students are expected to work together in pairs/groups to complete tasks in class.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1)	Understand the importance of active listening, and utilize its techniques.
(2)	Understand effective questioning techniques and explain how to use them.
(3)	Understand critical thinking skills and use them for problem solving.
(4)	Accurately explain the key points of effective team activities.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1)	Explain the meaning and importance of active listening.
(2)	Understand typical questioning techniques.
(3)	Understand critical thinking skills.
(4)	Roughly explain the key points of effective team activities.
